_comment: Copy this file to harness/seats.json (gitignored -- it holds API keys) and fill in real values. One entry per LLM seat: each gets its own Civ5 instance/profile/tuner port. `port` must be unique per seat and not 4318 (the primary/human instance, if any, keeps the default). `api_key` is what harness/http_server.py expects in the X-API-Key header for that seat -- generate one with `python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(24))"`. `allow_lua` defaults to false: the raw Lua escape-hatch endpoint is refused over HTTP unless explicitly enabled for that seat (see docs/NOTES.md on why -- an unguarded raw call already crashed this harness once).
